reading_rule: Each entry names its commit and the file's sha256 there, with the git blob for files on other branches; a value the study quotes from a file is read at that revision. revision_2026_11_07 lists what the revision of 7 November read after main f30408f7 was merged into the branch. first_reading_2026_11_04 keeps the first reading at the branch's parent as a historical record: six of its fifteen files differ at f30408f7 (the plan, the register and four products, whose only change the review of 6 November found to be rebound hashes).
